entities.name: Timer T3492
entities.description: Timer used during UE requested PDN disconnect procedure. On expiry, UE resends PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST and restarts timer. After fifth expiry, procedure is aborted.

entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnect procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to disconnect a PDN connection. Includes sending PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST and handling abnormal cases.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN disconnection. Retransmitted on T3492 expiry.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered after aborting PDN disconnect procedure on fifth T3492 expiry.

entities.name: Fifth expiry of timer T3492
entities.description: Condition when timer T3492 expires for the fifth time, leading to procedure abortion.

entities.name: Local deactivation of EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: Behavior where UE deactivates all EPS bearer contexts for the PDN connection locally without peer-to-peer signaling.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to synchronize EPS bearer context status with MME when returning to E-UTRAN coverage.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status IE
entities.description: Information element included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST to synchronize bearer context status.

entities.name: Collision with dedicated EPS bearer activation
entities.description: Condition when UE receives ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST during PDN disconnect procedure for same PDN.

entities.name: Collision with EPS bearer modification
entities.description: Condition when UE receives MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST during PDN disconnect procedure for same PDN.

entities.name: Collision with EPS bearer deactivation
entities.description: Condition when UE receives DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST during PDN disconnect procedure for dedicated bearer of same PDN.

relations.description: PDN disconnect procedure starts timer T3492.
PDN disconnect procedure includes sending PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message.
Fifth T3492 expiry establishes local deactivation of EPS bearer contexts.
Fifth T3492 expiry establishes transition to PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains EPS bearer context status IE.
Collision with dedicated bearer activation guards PDN disconnect procedure to ignore activation request.
Collision with bearer modification guards PDN disconnect procedure to ignore modification request.
Collision with bearer deactivation guards PDN disconnect procedure to proceed with both procedures.
